<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def pink_hash(slot):
    seg=current_frame.segmentation; nodes=seg['nodes']
    c0=15+slot*7
    for n in nodes:
        if n['color']=='B':
            b=n['boundary']; rs=[p[0] for p in b]; cs=[p[1] for p in b]
            if 50<=min(rs) and max(rs)<=58 and c0-1<=min(cs) and max(cs)<=c0+5:
                return n['hash'][:8]
    return None
def cursor_slot():
    seg=current_frame.segmentation
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='W':
            b=n['boundary']; rr=[p[0] for p in b]; cc=[p[1] for p in b]
            if 59<=min(rr) and max(rr)<=60:
                return round((min(cc)-15)/7)
    return None
cycles={}
cur=cursor_slot()
print("start slot",cur)
for s in range(5):
    # navigate to slot s
    d=s-cur
    if d>0: action(['RIGHT']*d)
    elif d<0: action(['LEFT']*-d)
    cur=s
    seq=[pink_hash(s)]
    for i in range(7):
        action(['UP']); seq.append(pink_hash(s))
    cycles[s]=seq[:7]
    print(f"slot{s}:",seq[:7])
# reference top grid pink tiles
seg=current_frame.segmentation; nodes=seg['nodes']
print("top pink: 6=",nodes[6]['hash'][:8],"8=",nodes[8]['hash'][:8],"18=",nodes[18]['hash'][:8],"20=",nodes[20]['hash'][:8],"31=",nodes[31]['hash'][:8],"33=",nodes[33]['hash'][:8])
</parameter>

<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def pink_hash(slot):
    seg=current_frame.segmentation; nodes=seg['nodes']
    c0=15+slot*7
    for n in nodes:
        if n['color']=='B':
            b=n['boundary']; rs=[p[0] for p in b]; cs=[p[1] for p in b]
            if 50<=min(rs) and max(rs)<=58 and c0-1<=min(cs) and max(cs)<=c0+5:
                return n['hash'][:8]
    return None
def cursor_slot():
    seg=current_frame.segmentation
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='W':
            b=n['boundary']; rr=[p[0] for p in b]; cc=[p[1] for p in b]
            if 59<=min(rr) and max(rr)<=60:
                return round((min(cc)-15)/7)
    return None
cycles={}
cur=cursor_slot()
print("start slot",cur)
for s in range(5):
    # navigate to slot s
    d=s-cur
    if d>0: action(['RIGHT']*d)
    elif d<0: action(['LEFT']*-d)
    cur=s
    seq=[pink_hash(s)]
    for i in range(7):
        action(['UP']); seq.append(pink_hash(s))
    cycles[s]=seq[:7]
    print(f"slot{s}:",seq[:7])
# reference top grid pink tiles
seg=current_frame.segmentation; nodes=seg['nodes']
print("top pink: 6=",nodes[6]['hash'][:8],"8=",nodes[8]['hash'][:8],"18=",nodes[18]['hash'][:8],"20=",nodes[20]['hash'][:8],"31=",nodes[31]['hash'][:8],"33=",nodes[33]['hash'][:8])
